title: HyperSVG 2.0 capability ladder: Give-way ladder
description: the give-way ladder at play (8.4, D2): give-way rules of kind fits, limit and keep run lowest priority first, with the same steps, priorities and floors as baking, so a live output and a baked one at the same size match | the text steps short, wrap, one-line, shrink, ellipsis and remove; and for keep, shrink, mark-only and simplify | the ladder's read-out (host.ladder(), the ambient layout value) gives each block's steps while playing | no content grammar of its own: give-way rules are core grammar. A package that needs fit and has a give-way rule of kind fits, limit or keep needs ladder too. A baked page needs none: the packer runs the ladder and the derived frames carry its result | choosing a content tier and its wording (7.9) stays in the core
